content.thinking:
Peak RSS 177MB — well under 2GiB. And total time 4.5s.

Let me also measure the Rust engine's memory for the worst case. Let me run the engine directly with /usr/bin/time or a resource check.

Let me measure the engine's max RSS for the torus3d stress input (the file I saved: /workspace/tmp/stress-input.txt).

Also, let me construct an even more memory-hungry case: many groups (8192) with many nodes (343) → g_ref 11MB. And tasks 100k. Let me test the engine's RSS.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
import resource, subprocess, os, time, json
BIN='/workspace/tmp/unit-merge-build/engine'
data=open('/workspace/tmp/stress-input.txt','rb').read()
print('payload MiB', len(data)/1048576)
b=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss
t0=time.time()
r=subprocess.run([BIN],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
print('rc',r.returncode,'time',round(time.time()-t0,2),'rss MiB',resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss/1024, 'out MiB', len(r.stdout)/1048576)
EOF
